question: Should this maintainer-labeled Playwright interaction refactor land after a representative after-fix real browser interaction and navigation-policy proof is attached?
rationale: The supplied CI and focused tests support the mechanical split, but this protected refactor moves runtime browser behavior across several modules and the public evidence does not yet show the actual post-refactor browser path.

options.title: Require live browser proof, then review
options.body: Attach a redacted terminal capture, runtime log, or recording showing a representative interaction and guarded navigation behavior after the split, then complete normal maintainer review.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Land based on focused tests and CI while accepting that the refactor has no posted runtime browser proof.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Defer the split if the team does not want to take the review burden for a large behavior-neutral browser-module relocation now.

recommendation.title: Require live browser proof, then review
recommendation.body: Attach a redacted terminal capture, runtime log, or recording showing a representative interaction and guarded navigation behavior after the split, then complete normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history identifies steipete as the contributor currently carrying this browser interaction boundary work.
